text.p: Swissair AG said all 2,900 staff of its technical services division had been transferred to SR Technics AG, a newly-created legal subsidiary of the SAirGroup.

Swissair said in a statement the legal independence of SR Technics would have no impact on its adherence to contracts and all assets necessary for carrying out aircraft maintenance, including the 50 percent stake in Shannon Aerospace Ltd., had been transferred to the new subsidiary.
SR Technics was made a legal subsidiary on January 1, 1997, part of the group's organisational restructuring that is aimed at improving transparency and profitability.

SR Technics, part of SAirGroup's new SAirServices division, should benefit from the move by concentrating on its core business and aligning its business to the competitive aircraft maintenance and engineering market, Swissair said.
Swissair will propose to its shareholders later this year that a holding company be created with the name of SAirGroup.
